speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Since you are presenting with a breast mass, please tell me if you have noticed any pain, skin changes like dimpling or redness, or nipple discharge? Also, have you had a recent mammogram or ultrasound, or is this a new finding?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Given the rapid growth and your age, have you noticed any changes in the nipple, such as inversion, discharge, or crusting? Also, are there any palpable lymph nodes in your armpit? REQUEST TEST: Mammogram with ultrasound of the left breast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography Findings: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy Microscopic Description: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your urgency, but a definitive diagnosis requires the imaging results to rule out conditions like a phyllodes tumor or aggressive carcinoma. The rapid growth and lack of pain are concerning features. Please confirm if you have noticed any axillary (armpit) lump or swelling while we wait for the mammogram and ultrasound.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor
